listing.name: Skies of Arcadia Legends (Skies of Arcadia Legends: Recompiled)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Native translated game plus Dolphin hardware code; select user-facing beta rather than assume newest perf-test artifact is recommended. Limits: Beta0.83 user route; perftest artifact is not necessarily recommended. Native translated game uses Dolphin hardware code. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64 package, Linux x86-64 AppImage/archive, macOS Apple-Silicon ARM64 archive; Android APK separate, ABI unknown in frozen research. Recommended beta differs from perftest channel. Original data: Own original USA GEAE8P / Europe GEAP8P / Japan GEAJ8P disc; multiple disc container formats. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
